Model-record license and byte-level provenance
The same exact model file is included at
`GPUMD-v5.0/potentials/nep/nep89_20250409/nep89_20250409.txt` in the authors'
Zenodo record, “Dataset and models supporting NEP89: Universal neuroevolution
potential for inorganic and organic materials across 89 elements”, version 2:
https://zenodo.org/records/19536370
DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19536370
The record's metadata declares CC BY 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The official `GPUMD-5.0-NEP89-Demos.zip` has MD5
`1f37b08eb334d60f4bd2338a6607751d`; its embedded model SHA-256 is identical to
the checkpoint distributed here. This is the model-file redistribution basis;
retain the attribution and record link when redistributing it. The record
authors are listed on its landing page, and the related paper is Ting Liang et
al., “NEP89: universal neuroevolution potential for inorganic and organic
materials across 89 elements”, Nature Computational Science (2026),
https://doi.org/10.1038/s43588-026-01009-6.

The pinned GPUMD v5.0 repository separately declares distribution of GPUMD
software under GNU GPL version 3. Its upstream README and license are retained
as provenance for that software snapshot; this notice does not infer the model
file's license from the software license or from the newer master branch's
source-code-only LGPL declaration. The accompanying `nep.in` is the unmodified
upstream model configuration. `provenance.json` records source URLs, version,
record metadata, byte counts and hashes.

Please cite the model authors when using NEP89 in research:
Ting Liang et al., NEP89: universal neuroevolution potential for inorganic and
organic materials across 89 elements. Nature Computational Science (2026).
https://doi.org/10.1038/s43588-026-01009-6
Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.21286

No warranty is provided. Element coverage alone
does not establish accuracy for a particular material or thermodynamic state.
The browser Rust/WASM implementation and model checkpoint retain separate
provenance; the app's MIT license does not replace the model record's CC BY 4.0.
